shared_elements: bird-headed creature / raptor head in profile
low-relief carving on a flat upright slab
animals/figures with clawed or taloned limbs
superposed registers of figures on a vertical field
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs bearing low-relief creatures including a bird-headed being in profile, a serpentine form, and a hatched linear band, and both use flat, outlined, minimally modelled relief with schematic anatomy. But A stacks several separate animals (quadruped, birds, arachnid-like form) in horizontal registers with no interaction, whereas B is dominated by a single large anthropomorphic winged bird-headed figure holding objects in each hand, a composition and figure-to-field relationship absent in A.
